newsitem.title: USA: Tribal leaders, business must cooperate -- Minn Fed.
newsitem.headline: Tribal leaders, business must cooperate -- Minn Fed.

text.p: Economic development on U.S. Indian reservations is not likely to be consistent unless tribal leaders and businessmen work together, said the head of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, Gary Stern.

"Economic development will not happen consistently without all partners working together," Stern told an audience of regional tribal leaders and businessmen gathered here for a Tribal Nation Bulding conference.
"Economic vitality on tribal lands should be benefitial for all. I encourage you to think and act creatively to make economic opportunity on reservations a reality," he added.
Stern declined to comment on any issues regarding either the current state of the economy or Federal Reserve monetary policy actions.
